statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service is to capture intermittent arrhythmic events
The service is to correlate events with symptomatic complaints of giddiness
The service is to guide further management
Diagnosis codes I47.1, I34.0 were submitted
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
